# Muelle

> Muelle is a free, MIT-licensed dock for Windows 11 written in Rust. It hides the Windows taskbar and replaces it with a macOS-style dock: icons that grow under the cursor, minimized windows that fold into their app's icon with the Genie effect (or, optionally, wait as live thumbnails), drag and drop onto apps, and an optional top menu bar that can show Claude and Codex plan usage. A small guardian process gives the taskbar back if the dock quits or crashes.

Muelle is not an Electron app: the dock is a native Win32 process that draws through the Windows composition engine. Measured on the author's PC: about 17 MB of private memory and no CPU while idle. The separate Settings window (Tauri 2 + WebView2) only runs while it is open.

## Download

- [Muelle-Setup.exe](https://github.com/crafter-station/Muelle/releases/latest/download/Muelle-Setup.exe): Windows 11, 64-bit, per user, no administrator rights.
- [All releases](https://github.com/crafter-station/Muelle/releases): version history and notes.

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/crafter-station/Muelle): Rust workspace. The dock is `apps/dock`, the settings window is `apps/settings` (Tauri 2 + React).
- [License](https://github.com/crafter-station/Muelle/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT.
- [Issues](https://github.com/crafter-station/Muelle/issues): bug reports and feature requests.

## Facts

- Platform: Windows 11 (single monitor is the supported case).
- Idle: about 17 MB of private memory and 0% CPU on the author's PC; no periodic timers while idle.
- Installer: about 2.4 MB, one step, no wizard and no admin rights.
- AI usage island: shown only while Claude Code or Codex is running; reads the sign-in those tools already keep locally and asks each provider for its own limits at most every five minutes. It can be turned off in Settings.
- Network: Settings checks GitHub Releases for updates (can be turned off); the AI usage island talks only to Anthropic and OpenAI. Nothing else is sent anywhere.
- Uninstall or quit: the Windows taskbar comes back, and uninstalling leaves Windows as it was.
- Not affiliated with Apple, Microsoft, Anthropic or OpenAI; the visual language is inspired by macOS, the icons and code are original.
